title: feat(service-ai): implement ObjectQL-backed persistent ConversationService
body:
`InMemoryConversationService` loses conversation history on restart. This adds a persistent implementation backed by `IDataEngine`, with auto-detection in the plugin.

### Object definitions (`src/objects/`)
- `ai_conversations` — `id`, `title`, `agent_id`, `user_id`, `metadata` (JSON), `created_at`, `updated_at` (both timestamps `readonly`)
- `ai_messages` — `id`, `conversation_id` (FK), `role`, `content`, `tool_calls` (JSON), `tool_call_id`, `created_at`

### `ObjectQLConversationService`
- Implements all 5 `IAIConversationService` methods via `IDataEngine`
- Snake_case DB columns ↔ camelCase API properties mapping with typed `DbConversationRow`/`DbMessageRow` interfaces
- JSON serialization for `metadata` and `toolCalls` fields with safe parsing (`safeParse` helper guards against invalid JSON in persisted data)
- Stable composite `(created_at, id)` ordering for deterministic pagination and message replay
- `$or`-based cursor pagination to avoid skips/duplicates when timestamps collide
- Parallel message loading via `Promise.all` in `list()`
- Cascade delete (messages first, then conversation)
- UUID generation via explicit `node:crypto` import (`randomUUID`)

### Plugin auto-detection
```typescript
// AIServicePlugin.init() resolution order:
// 1. Explicit options.conversationService
// 2. ctx.getService<IDataEngine>('data') → ObjectQLConversationService
// 3. InMemoryConversationService fallback
```

`AIServicePluginOptions` gains optional `conversationService` for explicit override. Plugin also registers `AiConversationObject` and `AiMessageObject` via `app.com.objectstack.service-ai` for ObjectQL auto-discovery.

### Tests
- 19 new test cases using an in-memory `IDataEngine` stub — covers CRUD, tool message round-trips, cursor pagination (no skips/duplicates), invalid JSON resilience, error paths, metadata JSON serialization
- All 79 tests pass (60 existing + 19 new)
